instruction: A candid documentary photograph from a wide, high angle shows an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor. The man in the dark grey t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the center-left, leaning forward with his right leg extended back, placing his right hand on the chest of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands upright on the center-right, facing him with her arms at her sides. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
